description: Land Acquisition - Compensation for the 9 Allotments of Land acquired in Imbulpe D/S Division has deposited in the District Court of Balangoda
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices of specific land parcels being acquired by the state, including case numbers, land names, plan numbers, lot numbers, extents, and compensation amounts. The content falls under "Land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category, with no government personnel changes or structural modifications mentioned.
